text:
Lina (Support): heads up — AcmeFoods reported double charge on renewal after PO attach. Invoice INV-001234 shows twice (INV-001234 and INV-001234-dup). one paid by PO (PO-4455) and one by card (card_ending_4242) for the same period. customer is asking for immediate reversal.

Sara (CS): omg. customer on a call now. can we do a quick reversal + note? they said it hit their finance team. cc @Ben Billing @Mike Payments

Ben Billing: got it. Lina can you paste the invoice ids + payment ids and timestamps?

Lina (Support): Invoice IDs: INV-001234 (created 2169993280) / INV-001234-dup (created 2169993301)
Payment IDs:
- pay_78abc (card, settled 2169993310)
- pay_po_4455 (po, recorded 2169993312)

Here's webhook trace snippet:
```
[2169993280] invoice.created id=INV-001234
[2169993300] payment.attempt id=pay_78abc status=settled
[2169993301] invoice.created id=INV-001234-dup
[2169993312] payment.recorded id=pay_po_4455 method=PO
```

Mike Payments: Hmm looks like we retried charge after PO attach and created a new invoice instead of linking to existing one. Can we check ledger.external_reference and the renew job id? @Josh E any recent changes to proration/po attach flow?

Josh E: There's an edgecase I pushed last month — if `po.attach` arrives within 60s of renewal, we may create a second invoice because dedupe key uses invoice_id not external_reference. Repro steps:
1) subscription renewal scheduled -> renewal_job_id=renew_555
2) PO attached (po.attach event bound to subscription) within 45s
3) scheduler triggers payment for renewal_job_id -> creates invoice again

I can push a hotfix to dedupe on `(subscription_id, billing_period_start)` today.

Priya (Finance): We need to reverse the customer-facing charge immediately. Refund card payment, create credit note for PO payment, accounting code 6410. Refund amount $1,200.00. Please include "Duplicate renewal - refund" in memo.

Ben Billing: Initiating refund for pay_78abc now. ops-bot will handle credit note.

ops-bot: Refund initiated: refund_2169993400 for pay_78abc amount $1,200.00, status=pending

Lina (Support): telling customer we've initiated refund and will post credit note. ETA 1-3 business days. Customer asked for refund confirmation email.

Mike Payments: Refund settled: refund_2169993400 status=settled 2169993504. Creating credit note for pay_po_4455.

ops-bot: Credit note created: CN-7788 linked to INV-001234-dup, amount $1,200.00

Priya (Finance): Confirming accounting entries created. Please send reconciliation id when available.

Josh E: Hotfix deployed to staging; will roll to prod in next slot. Patch: dedupe on external_reference + billing_period_start and add logging for `po.attach` race. PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/pull/813

Sara (CS): I'll follow up with customer and confirm refund + credit note. Thanks team. :tada:

Ben Billing: closing on our side once reconciliation id posted.

Lina (Support): customer updated, they confirmed charge reversed on their bank end during the call. I'll attach customer's finance contact and close after reconciliation.

Priya (Finance): Reconciliation ID: REC-5421

Lina (Support): marking thread resolved, will reopen if any issues.
